1.web: “However, Job, please hear my speech, and listen to all my words.
1.asv: Howbeit, Job, I pray thee, hear my speech, And hearken to all my words.

2.web: See now, I have opened my mouth. My tongue has spoken in my mouth.
2.asv: Behold now, I have opened my mouth; My tongue hath spoken in my mouth.

3.web: My words shall utter the uprightness of my heart. That which my lips know they shall speak sincerely.
3.asv: My wordsshall utterthe uprightness of my heart; And that which my lips know they shall speak sincerely.

4.web: The Spirit of God has made me, and the breath of the Almighty gives me life.
4.asv: The Spirit of God hath made me, And the breath of the Almighty giveth me life.

5.web: If you can, answer me. Set your words in order before me, and stand up.
5.asv: If thou canst, answer thou me; Setthy wordsin order before me, stand forth.

6.web: Behold, I am toward God even as you are. I am also formed out of the clay.
6.asv: Behold, I am toward God even as thou art: I also am formed out of the clay.

7.web: Behold, my terror shall not make you afraid, neither shall my pressure be heavy on you.
7.asv: Behold, my terror shall not make thee afraid, Neither shall my pressure be heavy upon thee.

8.web: “Surely you have spoken in my hearing, I have heard the voice of your words, saying,
8.asv: Surely thou hast spoken in my hearing, And I have heard the voice ofthywords, saying,

9.web: ‘I am clean, without disobedience. I am innocent, neither is there iniquity in me.
9.asv: I am clean, without transgression; I am innocent, neither is there iniquity in me:

10.web: Behold, he finds occasions against me. He counts me for his enemy.
10.asv: Behold, he findeth occasions against me, He counteth me for his enemy;

11.web: He puts my feet in the stocks. He marks all my paths.’
11.asv: He putteth my feet in the stocks, He marketh all my paths.

12.web: “Behold, I will answer you. In this you are not just, for God is greater than man.
12.asv: Behold, I will answer thee, in this thou art not just; For God is greater than man.

13.web: Why do you strive against him, because he doesn’t give account of any of his matters?
13.asv: Why dost thou strive against him, For that he giveth not account of any of his matters?

14.web: For God speaks once, yes twice, though man pays no attention.
14.asv: For God speaketh once, Yea twice, though man regardeth it not.

15.web: In a dream, in a vision of the night, when deep sleep falls on men, in slumbering on the bed;
15.asv: In a dream, in a vision of the night, When deep sleep falleth upon men, In slumberings upon the bed;

16.web: Then he opens the ears of men, and seals their instruction,
16.asv: Then he openeth the ears of men, And sealeth their instruction,

17.web: That he may withdraw man from his purpose, and hide pride from man.
17.asv: That he may withdraw man from his purpose, And hide pride from man;

18.web: He keeps back his soul from the pit, and his life from perishing by the sword.
18.asv: He keepeth back his soul from the pit, And his life from perishing by the sword.

19.web: He is chastened also with pain on his bed, with continual strife in his bones;
19.asv: He is chastened also with pain upon his bed, And with continual strife in his bones;

20.web: So that his life abhors bread, and his soul dainty food.
20.asv: So that his life abhorreth bread, And his soul dainty food.

21.web: His flesh is so consumed away, that it can’t be seen. His bones that were not seen stick out.
21.asv: His flesh is consumed away, that it cannot be seen; And his bones that were not seen stick out.

22.web: Yes, his soul draws near to the pit, and his life to the destroyers.
22.asv: Yea, his soul draweth near unto the pit, And his life to the destroyers.

23.web: “If there is beside him an angel, an interpreter, one among a thousand, to show to man what is right for him;
23.asv: If there be with him an angel, An interpreter, one among a thousand, To show unto man what is right for him;

24.web: then God is gracious to him, and says, ‘Deliver him from going down to the pit, I have found a ransom.’
24.asv: ThenGodis gracious unto him, and saith, Deliver him from going down to the pit, I have found a ransom.

25.web: His flesh shall be fresher than a child’s. He returns to the days of his youth.
25.asv: His flesh shall be fresher than a child’s; He returneth to the days of his youth.

26.web: He prays to God, and he is favorable to him, so that he sees his face with joy. He restores to man his righteousness.
26.asv: He prayeth unto God, and he is favorable unto him, So that he seeth his face with joy: And he restoreth unto man his righteousness.

27.web: He sings before men, and says, ‘I have sinned, and perverted that which was right, and it didn’t profit me.
27.asv: He singeth before men, and saith, I have sinned, and perverted that which was right, And it profited me not:

28.web: He has redeemed my soul from going into the pit. My life shall see the light.’
28.asv: He hath redeemed my soul from going into the pit, And my life shall behold the light.

29.web: “Behold, God works all these things, twice, yes three times, with a man,
29.asv: Lo, all these things doth God work, Twice, yea thrice, with a man,

30.web: to bring back his soul from the pit, that he may be enlightened with the light of the living.
30.asv: To bring back his soul from the pit, That he may be enlightened with the light of the living.

31.web: Mark well, Job, and listen to me. Hold your peace, and I will speak.
31.asv: Mark well, O Job, hearken unto me: Hold thy peace, and I will speak.

32.web: If you have anything to say, answer me. Speak, for I desire to justify you.
32.asv: If thou hast anything to say, answer me: Speak, for I desire to justify thee.

33.web: If not, listen to me. Hold your peace, and I will teach you wisdom.”
33.asv: If not, hearken thou unto me: Hold thy peace, and I will teach thee wisdom.
